title: Watering Plants II
goal: Water plants from both ends with the fewest required refills.
strategy: Each gardener waters the next plant from their own side, refilling only when necessary. If one middle plant remains, the gardener with more water handles it.

phasePurposes.start: Water plants from both ends with the fewest required refills.

edgeCases: One middle plant uses the fuller initial can
Every plant exactly empties a can
